skills.name: Words of Comfort
skills.description: Selects one enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to it.

skills.name: Words of Comfort - AoE
skills.description: Select an enemy target within 8 tiles and deals AoE Burn damage equal to 70% of attack to all enemy targets within a 5x5 tile area of it. Applies Overburn and Irritable for 2 turns and generates Incineration tiles for 2 turns.

skills.name: Words of Comfort - Targeted
skills.description:
Selects an enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Burn damage equal to 100% of attack to it.

Applies Overburn for 2 turns.

Gains Self-Suggestion for 3 turns.

skills.name: Safety First Principle
skills.description:
At the start of battle, gains Thermal Conduction. When a basic attack or Support Action deals AoE damage, gains 6 points of Searing Flame. When a basic attack or Support Action deals targeted damage, gains 3 points of Searing Flame.

When gaining Resilient Mind, it converts into an equal amount of Fortified Mind for 2 rounds.

When an enemy unit within range takes targeted damage from an ally, if Cecilia has Words of Comfort - AoE or Words of Comfort - Targeted, expends 3 points of Confectance Index and performs 1 instance of Support Action to it, dealing the same skill effect of the current Words of Comfort. This can be triggered up to 3 times per round.

After the Support Action resolves, gains 1 stack of Dedicated Effort for 2 turns and Resilient Mind for 2 rounds. The absorption amount of Resilient Mind is 50% of the applier's attack, up to a maximum of 100% of the target's max HP, and cannot stack; and applies Mutual Resonance to other allied units for 2 turns.

For each instance of Support Action performed, at the start of the next round, gains 3 points of Confectance Index.

When [doll:centaureissi] is on the field, the damage and healing she deals are increased by 100%, the damage multipliers of Cecilia's basic attack and her Support Action are increased by 30%. Cecilia can also gain Watchful Eye applied by [doll:centaureissi].

skills.name: Constructive Mediation
skills.description:
Basic attack Words of Comfort becomes Words of Comfort - AoE for 1 round.

Gains Extra Command and grants Resilient Mind to all allied Dolls for 2 rounds. Resilient Mind absorbs damage equal to 50% of the caster's attack, up to 100% of the target's max HP. Does not stack.

This skill or the active skill Desensitization Tactics can be used at most 1 time per round.

skills.name: Desensitization Tactics
skills.description:
Basic attack Words of Comfort changes to Words of Comfort - Targeted for 1 round.

Gains Extra Command and grants Resilient Mind to all allied Dolls for 2 rounds. Resilient Mind absorbs damage equal to 50% of the caster's attack, up to 100% of the target's max HP. Does not stack.

This skill or the active skill Constructive Mediation can be used at most 1 time per round.

skills.name: Reconciliation
skills.description:
Selects an enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Burn damage equal to 130% of attack to it.

Gains Extra Command.

For each basic attack or Support Action performed, the damage multiplier of the next usage of this skill is increased by 25%.

fortification.effect:
The damage multiplier of Words of Comfort - AoE is increased to 100%.

The effects of Irritable is enhanced: Damage taken from Cecilia is increased to 60%.

The damage multiplier of Words of Comfort - Targeted is increased to 130% and generates Incineration tiles within 2 tiles for 2 turns.

The effects of Self-Suggestion is enhanced: Burn damage dealt is increased by 30%, critical rate is increased by 50%, critical damage is increased by 50%.

Damage multiplier is increased to 160%, and the damage multiplier boost is increased to 50%.

Before the skill resolves, applies Fragile II to the target for 2 turns.

Cooldown time is reduced by 1 turn.

Damage dealt by Support Action is increased by 40% and stability damage dealt is increased by 2 points.

The effects of Mutual Resonance is enhanced: Burn damage dealt by Out-of-Turn Attack is increased by 30% and stability damage taken is reduced by 1 point.

If basic attack Words of Comfort is used after this skill resolves, the damage dealt is increased by 100%. When possessing Fortified Mind, critical rate is increased by 100% and critical damage is increased by 50%, stacking up to 2 times.

The stack limit of Dedicated Effort is increased to 10 stacks.

When an enemy unit within range takes targeted damage from an allied unit, Cecilia gains 1 stack of Dedicated Effort for 2 turns.

If Cecilia's critical rate is greater than 100%, the excess critical rate is converted to an equal percentage of basic attack damage multiplier.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Emotional Stability
keys.effect: Gains 3 points of Confectance Index at the start of the battle.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Affinity Charm
keys.effect: Before making a basic attack, cleanses 1 buff from the enemy target.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Graceful Turn
keys.effect: After using the basic attack Words of Comfort, gains 4 tiles of Additional Movement and cleanses 1 debuff from self.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Harmless Disguise
keys.effect:
After action ends, gains Resilient Mind for 2 rounds.

The absorption amount of Resilient Mind is 50% of the applier's attack, up to a maximum of 100% of the target's max HP.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Fatal Insight
keys.effect: When possessing Fortified Mind, Burn damage dealt from Out-of-Turn Attack is increased by 15%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Self-Motivation
keys.effect:
Before dealing AoE damage, gains Coverage Boost II for 2 turns.

Before dealing targeted damage, gains Targeted Attack Boost II  for 2 turns.

keys.name: Common Key - Understanding Is My Strength
keys.effect: While this unit has Shield effects, Burn damage dealt is increased by 10%.
